topFindings.title: DrawMesh is a ~2,670-line function inside a 7,017-line monolith TU
topFindings.evidence: Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp DrawMesh spans lines 3837-6510; the whole file is 7017 lines. DC3's equivalent DrawMeshImmediate is ~170 lines (Mesh_Wgpu.cpp:159-332).

topFindings.title: Renderer is content-coupled: ~30 hardcoded RB3 asset-name branches in DrawMesh
topFindings.evidence: grep of strcmp/strstr on mesh/mat/dir names in Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp = 30 sites: scrollbar.mesh, prism_gem, gem_smasher, highlight_main, goatee, fingernails, trackjacket, peakstate, etc. Each is a per-asset workaround for a general-pipeline defect (scrollbar thumb ~4536, hub bar ~4505).

topFindings.title: Mutable mSceneBindGroup re-created an unbounded number of times mid-frame is a state-leak vector
topFindings.evidence: WriteSceneUniforms (1297) creates a new mSceneBindGroup at 1581; DrawMesh re-invokes it per-mesh on cam re-pose (V13, 3912-3925) and per-environ (3934-3940). Draws implicitly depend on the last write; correctness hinges on engine call order. mLastSceneCamPose 6-float dirty compare at 3915-3919.

topFindings.title: RB3 backend is a self-contained reimplementation of 8 DC3 backend files
topFindings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:322 MILO_ENGINE_GPU_PLATFORM_SOURCES_RB3 excludes MeshGpuCache/MaterialSetup/Mesh_Wgpu/Part_Wgpu/Tex_Wgpu/TransparentQueue/RndTex_Native (all dc3-only, CMake:304-312). RB3 inlines per-mesh cache, material setup, DXT unpack, particles, postproc, quad — comments at RB3:389/5766/5974/2665 cite the files it was copied from.

topFindings.title: No transparent/depth-sorted pass in the RB3 backend
topFindings.evidence: TransparentQueue users are only TransparentQueue.cpp, Rnd_Wgpu.cpp, Mesh_Wgpu.cpp (DC3). Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp never references it; draws in engine submission order with per-material zMode + a text zMode=Disable special-case (6318).

topFindings.title: ~90 env flags / 113 getenv calls; ~20 guard unfixed-bug workarounds (not features)
topFindings.evidence: grep -c getenv Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp = 113. W-class flags include RB3_VENUE_LIGHT_OFF, RB3_TRACK_LIGHT_OFF, RB3_SCROLLBAR_THUMB_FIX_OFF, RB3_NO_HUB_BAR_PLACEMENT_FIX, RB3_BAND_SHARD_WORLDFLOOR/CAP/RATIOCAP, RB3_NO_SKIN_CLAMP, RB3_NO_SKEL_REBAKE — each toggles a hack standing in for a real fix.

topFindings.title: 5 inline WGSL shader modules duplicate existing gfx/ passes; no .wgsl files, no offline validation
topFindings.evidence: kRB3HaloBlitShaderSource(2350), kRB3PostProcShaderSource(2703, hand-port of gfx/PostProcPass.cpp per comments 2665/3033/3060), kRB3QuadShaderSource(3267, dup of gfx/DrawRect2D.cpp), kRB3ComposeShaderSource(3376), kRB3ParticleShaderSource(6631). Only standard_wgsl.inc is file-backed/hot-reloadable.

topFindings.title: GameRenderHook seam exists but is never wired for RB3; game-specific logic lives inline in the engine instead
topFindings.evidence: rb3_render_hook.cpp:14-20 states the RB3 renderer path is not linked so the hook is never called; the ~30 asset-name behaviors that DC3 routes through the hook are inlined into engine DrawMesh.

refactorRecs: Phase A (mechanical, byte-identical, one move per commit, visual-diff gated): externalize the 5 inline WGSL modules to src/gfx/Shaders/*.wgsl with offline naga validation; extract RB3MeshEntry upload cache, material->uniform binder, and postproc/halo/quad into TUs, converging onto gfx/PostProcPass + gfx/DrawRect2D where provably identical; dedupe BandUniformRing vs UniformRingBuffer into one ring.

Phase B (seam, no behavior change): wire GameRenderHook for the RB3 backend and relocate the ~30 asset-name branches from engine DrawMesh into rb3/native/src/rb3_render_hook.cpp, one behavior per commit behind its existing RB3_* flag; replace the mutable mSceneBindGroup member with an immutable-per-write scene bind group passed via a per-draw DrawContext to eliminate the state-leak class.

Phase C (correctness, now safe): adopt TransparentQueue for a real depth-sorted transparent pass (retire the text zMode=Disable special-case); fix the general skinning/transform/lighting pipelines (lanes 02/03/04) and delete each W-class workaround flag + name-branch as it is subsumed.

Target structure: shared src/render/ core (RenderFrame, SceneUniforms, MaterialBinder, MeshUploadCache, DrawList) + thin BandRnd/WgpuRnd adapters in src/platform/; interface is a DrawContext value carrying per-draw world/material/bones/pipeline-key so state is passed, not left in mutable members.
Hard rule enforced throughout: a commit either MOVES code or CHANGES behavior, never both — this is the exact discipline whose absence caused the C8/BandPatchMesh regressions per the memory notes.
